title: milestones.v1 — per-archetype plan-milestone spec (eval/plans/<slug>.milestones.json)
description: Data-driven milestone definitions consumed by eval/plan_adherence.py (axis 4, PLAN). All extractors are text/regex over logged decision rows and prompt snapshots — no judge model, no card database. Every card name listed anywhere in a spec MUST appear verbatim in the matching eval/decks/<slug>.txt decklist (validated by plan_adherence.py --strict-specs and test_plan_adherence.py); a typo'd name silently zeroes a milestone, which is the dominant failure mode of text extractors. Schema is ADDITIVE-ONLY: consumers read with .get().

deck.description: Deck slug; MUST equal the filename stem (<slug>.milestones.json) and an eval/decks/<slug>.plan stem.

plan_file.description: Repo-relative path to the plan text the milestones were derived from, e.g. eval/decks/ur-delver.plan.

threat_names.description: Card names used by the requires_state predicate 'own_threat_on_battlefield' (matched as substrings of the YOU board: line).

combo_pieces.description: Default piece list for combo_assembly_progress milestones that omit piece_names.

fixtures.description: Repo-relative jsonl paths of REAL logged games hand-checked against this spec. May be [] when no logged games exist for the archetype yet (then set fixtures_note). Never invented paths; tests never read runs/.

requires_state.description: Predicate over the decision row's prompt snapshot. A string ('own_threat_on_battlefield': any spec threat_names substring-matches the YOU board line) or an object whose keys AND together. ONLY the keys below are derivable from the prompt text; in particular THERE IS NO STORM COUNT IN THE PROMPT — casts_this_turn_at_least is derived by counting RECENT EVENTS '<seat> cast <Card>' lines (both players) since the last 'Turn <N> (<seat>)' marker, and does not include the spell currently being decided.

own_yard_count_at_least.description: Sum of substring occurrences of the names in the YOU yard(N): line must be >= n.

description.description: Must cite the exact .plan sentence the milestone comes from.

turn_max.description: deploy_by_turn: attained iff the seat's first chosen option matching any name (with require_prefix if given) occurred at turn <= turn_max. 99 means 'ever'.

require_prefix.description: Prefix the chosen option text must start with. deploy_by_turn default null (any). sequence_order/payoff_condition default 'CAST' (activated abilities also render with the CAST prefix in these logs; null matches any prefix, needed e.g. for PLAY LAND or Show-and-Tell entity picks).

within_turn.description: sequence_order: true = a first-match must precede a then-match WITHIN one turn; false = anywhere later in the game.

denominator.description: resource_discipline: rate = times chosen / times offered in type=='play' option menus.

zones.description: combo_assembly_progress: YOU-section zones scanned for piece_names. Exile and library are NOT visible in the prompt.

spells.description: target_split: only count target rows whose prompt contains 'TARGET for <spell>' for one of these.
